written_by: agent (Claude, gbrain-evals follow-up round lane B), reading gbrain c5fb0201 src/core around the 12 known gold files
rules: two questions per gold file; each describes behavior of the file's named symbol or its file without using the symbol's identifier or the file name

questions.text: Where does the pipeline start that classifies a question's intent, gathers evidence from the brain and asks a model to write a synthesized answer?
Which code optionally adds the holder's calibration profile and a trajectory block to the answer prompt before calling the model?
Which storage backend runs an embedded Postgres compiled to WebAssembly, loading the vector and trigram extensions from bundled assets?
Where is the in-process database engine that keeps chunk invalidation and chunk replacement atomic inside transaction clones?
Which function merges keyword and vector result lists with reciprocal rank fusion, then boosts compiled truth and re-scores by cosine similarity?
Where is the query embedding raced against a shared deadline so a slow embedder cannot stall retrieval?
Which function parses a markdown string, hashes it, and writes the page version, tags and chunks in one transaction?
Where is a page body rejected when its UTF-8 byte length is over the maximum file size, so a remote caller cannot run up the embedding bill?
Which parser finds markdown links that point at people or company pages, accepting both relative file paths and bare slugs?
Where are references inside fenced or inline code blocks skipped when collecting links to person and company pages?
Which code decides which vector column a query searches: a per-call override first, then the database default, then the standard column?
Where does an unknown vector column name raise an error that includes a paste-ready hint for registering it?
Which ranking stage gives a small score bump to a top result that several other top results link to?
Where are several results from the same chat session demoted so only the best of them keeps its full score?
Which code generates ideas by crossing close pages found by search with far pages from a domain bank, then has a judge score them?
Where is a cost estimate printed with a short grace period before the idea-generation model calls begin?
Where is the single seam every model call goes through, configured once at startup instead of reading environment variables at call time?
Which module turns SDK errors into configuration errors and transient errors and caches provider clients by model and base URL?
Which helper maps a bare first name to an existing people page instead of creating a stub page at the brain root?
Where is a stub page redirected to its canonical page by fuzzy title match and then by people or companies prefix expansion, skipping the exact-slug step?
Which code turns a brain health report into an ordered list of fix-up steps for the doctor's repair plan?
Where are extra repair steps from doctor checks merged into the built-in plan and deduplicated by id, with the built-in entry winning?
Which method submits a background job, deduplicating by idempotency key and capping how many children a parent job may have?
Where does the Postgres-backed job system lock the parent row while a child job is submitted, so concurrent submissions cannot exceed the cap?
